description.value: Potato Corner is a fast-food outlet specializing in flavored fries, part of an internationally recognized franchise brand. Located in a unit along Kingsway in Vancouver, it offers takeout service and appears to have a food truck component based on website navigation. A quick stop for a cyclist looking for a hot, carb-heavy snack along one of East Vancouver's busiest commercial corridors.
